offers.offerName: Magenta® Plus Business Tablet with 10GB of high-speed hotspot data (TI)
offers.description: This Magenta Plus Business Tablet plan provides: Taxes and fees are included in monthly service price. The price you see is the price you pay. All Unlimited. ALL IN! Unlimited 5G/4G LTE data on our network so you can watch, stream and play all day! No data overages. 10GB of 5G/4G LTE mobile hotspot data, then at max 3G speeds after that. Plus data in Mexico and Canada with up to 5GB of 5G/4G LTE at no extra charge! Get unlimited data at 2G speeds almost everywhere else in the world. Capable device required; coverage not available in some areas. $40 discount when you also have a qualifying voice plan on your account. Use AutoPay to get $5 off your monthly service up to 8 lines. Video typically streams on smartphone/tablet at DVD quality (480p) unless HD pass is activated. During congestion, customers on this plan may notice speeds lower than other customers and further reduction if using >50GB/mo., due to data prioritization. For tablets, on-device usage is prioritized over tethering usage, which may result in higher speeds for data used on device.

offers.offerName: Business Unlimited Select 30 Month Subsidy 2.0 Tier D
offers.description: Business Unlimited for Phones includes unlimited talk, text, and data on our advanced network with no data overages. You can also call, text, and use up to 5GB of 4G LTE data in Mexico and Canada at no extra charge. You get unlimited text and 2G data roaming in more than 210 countries and destinations, unlimited domestic data roaming and unlimited video streaming at DVD quality, 5GB of 4G LTE hotspot data (with unlimited max 3G hotspot speeds thereafter), free texting and a free hour of Wi-Fi on Gogo-enabled flights--all included at no extra charge. Video typically streams on smartphone/tablet at DVD quality (480p) unless you add an HD Day Pass. Subsidy plans include part or all of the cost of a phone in the monthly charge, and a two-year service agreement is required. If you cancel service, you may be charged a subsidy repayment (1/30th of subsidy per month remaining). Coverage not available in some areas. During congestion, a small fraction of customers using >50GB/mo. may notice reduced speeds until next bill cycle due to data prioritization.

The result -- instant one-touch pairing2, Automatic Switching3, Audio Sharing4, and hands-free "Hey Siri" for Apple devices. post.description: Retrieves real-time inventory availability and estimated shipping details for one or more products across specified warehouse or distribution center locations.This API allows clients to submit a list of product SKUs with optional quantity and location information, and receive detailed inventory responses including stock status, available quantities, fulfillment location, and estimated shipping date range.It supports bulk inventory checks, enabling partners or internal systems to efficiently determine product availability before placing orders or reserving stock.

organizationId.description: Unique identifier for the organization making the request. Used to scope catalog results to a specific organization.

billingAccountNumber.description: The 9-digit T-Mobile billing account number used to identify the customer account. Required for all catalog queries.

offerType.description: Type of product being queried. Acceptable values: DEVICE, ACCESSORY, PLAN, SERVICE.

deviceOfferIds.description:
List of one or more unique device offer IDs to filter catalog results. Used when retrieving plans or services compatible with specified devices.

 Note: Currently one item is supported.

planOfferIds.description:
List of one or more unique rate plan offer IDs to filter catalog results. Used when retrieving devices or services compatible with specified rate plans.

 Note: Currently one item is supported.

offset.description: The starting page number for paginated results. Default is 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Default is 100.

offerId.description: Unique identifier assigned to the catalog offer.

offerType.description: The category of the offer (DEVICE, PLAN, SERVICE, or ACCESSORY).

offerName.description: The name of the offer as marketed to customers.

prices.description:
Array of price-related attributes for the offer. Only applicable key/value pairs are returned. If a price attribute is not relevant, it will not appear in the response.

### Supported Keys

Key | Possible Values | Description
--- | ---------------- | -----------
`recurringFrequency` | one-time / monthly / annual | Indicates whether the charge is one-time or recurring, and the frequency if recurring
`offerPrice` | Decimal (e.g., 399.99) | The current price being offered to the customer
`listPrice` | Decimal (e.g., 499.99) | The standard or original price before discounts or promotions

eip.description: Details of an Equipment Installment Plan (EIP) for the offer. Only applicable if the product is eligible for installment financing.

minInstallment.description: Minimum installment amount eligible for the plan.

salePrice.description: Total sale price of the device or accessory.

downPayment.description: Amount required upfront at the time of purchase.

numInstallment.description: Number of installments in the plan.

offerCharacteristics.description:
Array of additional characteristics of the offer. Only applicable key with true value pairs are returned.

### Supported Keys by Offer Type

#### Device
Key | Possible Values | Description
--- | ---------------- | -----------
`stockKeepingUnit` | SKU  | Device identifier
`sim` | true / false | Indicates if SIM 
`preOrder` | true / false | Indicates if device can be pre ordered 
`simType` | eSIM/pSIM/peSIM(pSIM+eSIM)| Indicates type of sim supported for device 

#### Accessory
Key | Possible Values | Description
--- | ---------------- | -----------
`stockKeepingUnit` | SKU  | Accessory identifier
`simStarterKit` | true / false | Indicates if SIM starter kit

#### Rate Plan
Key | Possible Values | Description
--- | ---------------- | -----------
`serviceOfferingCode` | SOC | Service offering identifier
`planType` | Value / Classic | Type of plan
`autoPayEligible` | true / false | Eligible for AutoPay
`mobileBroadband` | true / false | Mobile broadband plan
`poolingPlan` | true / false | Indicates if plan supports pooling
`poolingPlanServiceOfferingCode` | SOC | Associated pooling plan identifier(Base pooling plan)
`poolingPlanMaxLines` | Integer (e.g., 100) | Maximum lines allowed in pooling plan
`poolingPlanMinLines` | Integer (e.g., 10) | Minimum lines required in pooling plan
`taxTreatment` | TAX_INCLUSIVE / TAX_EXCLUSIVE | Tax treatment applied
`addALine` | true / false | Indicates if plan supports add-a-line
`subsidyPlan` | true / false | Indicates if plan is subsidy-based

#### Service
Key | Possible Values | Description
--- | ---------------- | -----------
`serviceOfferingCode` | SOC | Service offering identifier
`category` | Data, International , Other | Category of the service
`taxTreatment` | TAX_INCLUSIVE / TAX_EXCLUSIVE | Tax treatment applied

manufacturer.description: Brand or manufacturer of the device or accessory, if applicable.

description.example: This plan includes: • The price you see is the price you pay. Taxes and fees included. • High-speed data in the U.S. - plus use up to 5GB of your high-speed data in Canada and Mexico at no extra charge. • Up to 6 GB of monthly high-speed mobile internet access. Speeds slowed to up to 2G speeds after 6 GB. • No annual service contract. No overages. • Video typically streams on smartphone or tablet at DVD quality (480p). • Unlimited international web at up to 128kbps while roaming in 210+ countries and destinations. • Tethering at max 3G speeds. On all T-Mobile plans during congestion the small fraction of customers using >50GB/mo. may notice reduced speeds until next bill cycle due to data prioritization. • Plans do not include data stash, music freedom, or binge on.
description.description: Marketing or technical description of the offer, which may include features, terms, and limitations.

productImage.description: URL path to a representative product image.

compatibleDevices.description: Specifies the list of device identifiers with which this product is functionally compatible. Commonly used for accessories, services, or plans to ensure they can be correctly paired with eligible devices in the T-Mobile ecosystem.Reserved for future use.

compatiblePlans.description: Specifies the list of rate plan identifiers that are valid and compatible with this product. Typically applied to devices or services to confirm eligibility and seamless integration with approved T-Mobile rate plans.Reserved for future use.

offset.description: The page number of the current response.

limit.description: Number of results returned per page.

total.description: Total number of offers matching the query.

organizationId.description: A unique identifier assigned to a top-level business account or enterprise customer within T-Mobile systems.

billingAccountNumber.description: The 9-digit T-Mobile billing account number used to identify the customer account.

ShippingChargesResponse.description: Response containing shipping charges and any applicable waivers.

shippingWaiver.description: Indicates whether shipping charges are waived (true = free shipping, false = charges apply).

shippingCharges.description: A list of shipping charges, where each object defines the cost of a given shipping service for a specified weight threshold, unit of measure, and currency.

shippingType.description: Shipping service code that uniquely identifies the shipping method (e.g., OVN(Overnight Shipping), STN(Standard Shipping)).

shippingTypeDescription.description: Human-readable description of the shipping type, suitable for display in user interfaces or invoices.(e.g., Overnight Shipping , Standard Shipping

unitOfWeight.description: Unit of measure used for the weight threshold (scaleQuantity).

scaleQuantity.description: Maximum package weight covered by this charge tier, expressed in the given unit.

charge.description: Charge amount for shipping in the specified currency.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the charge’s currency.

ProductInventoryRequest.description: Represents a list of product inventory requests within the United States, where each item specifies the SKU, quantity for which inventory availability needs to be checked. Inventory information is provided only for locations supported within the U.S. region.

stockKeepingUnit.description: Unique product identifier such as SKU or material number used to query or report inventory.

quantity.description: Number of units requested for the specified SKU

ProductInventoryResponse.description: Provides detailed inventory information corresponding to each requested product SKU, including availability status, available quantity, and estimated shipping dates.

stockKeepingUnit.description: Unique product identifier such as SKU or material number used to query or report inventory.

status.description: Indicates the current stock availability for the product —  InStock, Out of Stock, or BackOrder

estimatedShippingDateFrom.description: The earliest estimated date (in UTC format) when the product is expected to be shipped. This represents the start of the estimated shipping window.

estimatedShippingDateTo.description: The latest estimated date (in UTC format) by which the product is expected to be shipped . This represents the end of the estimated shipping window.

Access-Control-Request-Headers.description: Used in CORS pre-flight requests to list custom headers the actual request will include.
Access-Control-Request-Headers.name: Access-Control-Request-Headers

Access-Control-Request-Method.description: Used in CORS pre-flight (browser) requests to indicate the HTTP method of the actual request. For example, POST. (Typically handled by browsers automatically and not used in direct API calls.)
Access-Control-Request-Method.name: Access-Control-Request-Method

activity-id.description: A unique identifier for the request, generated to track the service request. This is used for tracing a specific API call.
activity-id.name: activity-id

interaction-id.description: An identifier to group a series of related calls as part of a single user interaction or business activity. For instance, multiple API calls triggered by one user action share the same interaction-id.
interaction-id.name: interaction-id

service-transaction-id.description: A request ID that, if provided, will be echoed back by the server in responses. This can be used to match requests with responses. If not provided, the server generates the service-request-id.
service-transaction-id.name: service-transaction-id

session-id.description: A token to track a series of transactions in a session. This might represent a user’s session or any logical grouping of requests.
session-id.name: session-id

workflow-id.description: Indicates the business use case or workflow type for the request. For example, ACTIVATION or another keyword identifying the type of operation.
workflow-id.name: workflow-id

x-auth-originator.description: (Originator-Auth-Token) - A JWT access token representing the original caller in a chain of API calls. Used when one service calls this API on behalf of an end-user or another service. This helps preserve the identity of the originator.
x-auth-originator.name: x-auth-originator

channel-origin.description: Identifies the source platform or channel through which the order was placed. Used for reporting, auditing, and engagement analysis.
channel-origin.name: channel-origin

x-authorization.description: (Proof-of-Possession Token) – A security token proving the caller’s authorization, typically a Proof-of-Possession token or OAuth access token. This header carries the token that authenticates the API caller’s identity and permissions.
x-authorization.name: x-authorization
